description: The methods this running app answers (names only).
name: rpc.methods

description: The app: its name, pid, frames drawn, window size in points, the framebuffer scale, and whether its window is visible.
name: app.info

description: The app's log since a cursor: pass the returned next_seq as since_seq to get only what is new. `dropped` > 0 means the ring wrapped and records were lost before they were read.
name: app.logs

since_seq.description: Return records with seq >= this (0: from the oldest kept).

description: Quits the app (as closing its window would); answers before it goes.
name: app.quit

description: Waits until the app has drawn this many more frames (default 1).
name: frame.wait

description: Every ImGui window and item drawn in the last frame: ref, window, label, rect [x, y, w, h] in window points, and state (checkable/checked, openable/opened, inputable, disabled, visible). Static text is not an item: use the app's own state methods or a screenshot to read it.
name: ui.snapshot

interactive_only.description: Only items that take input (default false).

window.description: Only items of this window (its name).

description: Resolves a target to one item (its ref, window, label, rect and state).
name: ui.find

target.description: An ImGui item: its ref from ui.snapshot ('#1a2b3c4d', stable while the item exists), 'Window/Label' (the window's name and the item's visible label), or a bare label. Matching nothing or more than one item is an error that lists the candidates.

description: A PNG of the next frame drawn: the whole window, an item's rect (target) or a rect in points. Returns png_base64, scale (image px per point), logical_rect [x, y, w, h] in points and image_size; an image pixel (px, py) is the point (logical_rect.x + px / scale, logical_rect.y + py / scale).
name: ui.screenshot

max_size.description: Downscale so the longer side is at most this many px (default 1600).

rect.description: [x, y, w, h] in window points.

target.description: An ImGui item: its ref from ui.snapshot ('#1a2b3c4d', stable while the item exists), 'Window/Label' (the window's name and the item's visible label), or a bare label. Matching nothing or more than one item is an error that lists the candidates.

description: Waits until an item exists (or is gone, or is enabled), checking each frame. Errors with `timeout` if it does not happen within timeout_ms.
name: ui.wait_for

target.description: An ImGui item: its ref from ui.snapshot ('#1a2b3c4d', stable while the item exists), 'Window/Label' (the window's name and the item's visible label), or a bare label. Matching nothing or more than one item is an error that lists the candidates.

description: Clicks an item (at its centre, or at x, y within it) or a point in the window. Synthesised through ImGui's input queue, so it reaches the 3D view as well as widgets.
name: input.click

modifiers.description: Modifier keys held during the action (alt = Option, super = Cmd).

target.description: An ImGui item: its ref from ui.snapshot ('#1a2b3c4d', stable while the item exists), 'Window/Label' (the window's name and the item's visible label), or a bare label. Matching nothing or more than one item is an error that lists the candidates.

x.description: Window points (with a target: points from the item's top left).

y.description: Window points (with a target: points from the item's top left).

description: Moves the mouse to a point in the window (hover).
name: input.move

description: Presses at `from`, moves in steps to `to` and releases: orbiting (left) or panning (right) the 3D view, a slider, or with modifiers a lasso in the scanning app (shift: select).
name: input.drag

modifiers.description: Modifier keys held during the action (alt = Option, super = Cmd).

path.description: Instead of from/to: every [x, y] point of the drag in order (e.g. a lasso outline).

steps.description: Intermediate moves between from and to (default 12).

description: Scrolls the mouse wheel at a point (zooms the 3D view).
name: input.scroll

dy.description: Vertical wheel steps (positive: up / zoom in).

x.description: Window points (default: where the mouse is).

y.description: Window points (default: where the mouse is).

description: Presses and releases a key (ImGui key names: 'Escape', 'Delete', 'Backspace', 'Enter', 'Z', 'Space', 'F1', ...).
name: input.key

modifiers.description: Modifier keys held during the action (alt = Option, super = Cmd).

description: Types text into the focused text field.
name: input.type

description: Everything about the scanning app now: connection, workflow step and scan type, whether it is scanning, the HUD (tracking, fps, frames, model points, markers, distance), the recording, processing, editing and view state.
name: scan.state

description: Connects the scanner over USB, or the built-in emulator (a simulated scanner and scene, no hardware).
name: device.connect

emulator.description: Use the emulator instead of a scanner.

description: Disconnects (stops scanning).
name: device.disconnect

description: Opens a workflow step (as clicking its header). Not while scanning.
name: workflow.goto

description: The scan type: hybrid (surface + markers, the default), surface (shape only) or global_markers (capture and optimise a marker map first). Not while scanning.
name: scan.set_type

description: Starts or resumes scanning (opens the scan step).
name: scan.start

description: Pauses scanning; the model and recording are kept.
name: scan.pause

description: Opens a recording (.estr) as a paused scan: its model is rebuilt from the recorded poses, and it can be viewed, edited (edit.*) and processed without a scanner. With the scanner it was made with connected, scan.start continues it: the scanner finds its place on the model and new frames are appended to the same file. Answers when loaded, or with loading=true if it takes longer (then scan.state's 'load').
name: scan.open

description: A new scan: clears the model and starts a new recording.
name: scan.new

discard.description: Delete the current recording (default false: it is kept).

description: Reads, and with any field given changes, the scanner's settings.
name: scan.settings

description: Bundle-adjusts the captured global markers into a fixed map (markers step, paused).
name: markers.optimize

description: Discards the global markers (and their map).
name: markers.clear

description: Saves the global-marker map.
name: markers.save

description: Loads a global-marker map.
name: markers.load

description: Processes the recorded scan into a mesh (in the background; poll process.status). Not while scanning.
name: process.run

description: Processing: running, stage, fraction, done, summary.
name: process.status

description: Cancels processing.
name: process.cancel

description: Exports the processed mesh (.stl, .ply or .obj by extension).
name: process.export

description: The 3D view's camera (target, distance, orientation as a quaternion [w, x, y, z], eye, forward) and options.
name: view.get

description: Moves the 3D view's camera (leaves follow mode) and/or changes its options. Orientation takes camera axes (x right, y down, z forward) to world axes.
name: view.set

orbit.description: [dx, dy] radians, as a left-drag would.

reset.description: Back to the default view first.

description: Adds a lasso stroke to the selection (paused scans): a polygon in window points, as seen in the current view; everything inside it, front to back, is selected (subtract: removed from the selection).
name: edit.select

description: Clears the selection.
name: edit.clear

description: Deletes the selection from the live model and the recording (processing never sees it); undoable until scanning resumes. Answers once done.
name: edit.delete

description: Undoes the last delete. Answers once done.
name: edit.undo

description: Selection strokes, undoable deletes, the last message.
name: edit.status

description: The calibration app now: connection, the 25-view plan with what is captured, the active group, the live view (distance, tilts, roll, offset, hints, whether in position and steady), lighting, and the solve.
name: calib.state

description: Connects the scanner, or the emulator (a simulated scanner and board).
name: calib.connect

description: Disconnects.
name: calib.disconnect

description: Selects the orientation group to capture next: 0 face-on, 1 top edge near, 2 bottom edge near, 3 right edge near, 4 left edge near.
name: calib.group

description: Turns capturing automatically when steady on or off.
name: calib.auto_capture

description: Captures the current view now (as the Capture now button).
name: calib.capture

description: Clears one capture, or all of them (a new session).
name: calib.clear

description: Loads a folder of captures (imageLeftN / imageRightN).
name: calib.load_folder

description: Loads a reference calibration to compare with.
name: calib.load_reference

description: Solves the stereo calibration from the captures (background; poll calib.state).
name: calib.solve

description: Saves the solved calibration (returns the path).
name: calib.save

description: What writing to the scanner would do: the gates (all must pass), the backup path.
name: calib.plan_write

description: Writes the solved calibration into the scanner's flash (stream paused, current pages backed up first, read back and verified). Real hardware: this replaces the scanner's calibration.
name: calib.write

description: Puts a calibration backup back into the scanner's flash.
name: calib.restore

description: Reads, and with any field given changes, the lighting.
name: calib.lighting

description: Shows a tab of the main view.
name: calib.tab

description: The whole document: the scan (size, bounds, voxel), every label (role, triangles, painted seeds, fitted and solved surface, noise), holes, fillets, datums, constraints with their status from the last solve, the built model's state, and undo depth. Start here, and check it after changes.
name: model.summary

description: One label in detail: its surface, area, centroid, bounds and the labels it borders.
name: model.label

label.description: A label: its name or id.

description: How far the scan is from the built model: overall and per label (rms, p95, max, share within tolerance), hot spots (patches beyond tolerance: centroid, size, mean and peak, the model face and label), the number of edge bands (thin strips where the scan rounds sharp edges: expected, not errors), and model faces the scan does not cover. + means the scan lies outside the model (material missing from the model).
name: model.deviation

max_hot_spots.description: At most this many hot spots (default 10).

description: The scan point (and its label) where a ray first meets the scan.
name: model.raycast

description: The undo and redo steps (description and author).
name: model.history

description: Opens a document (.emodel) or a scan to model: an .estr recording (processed first: seconds to minutes), or an STL/PLY mesh. A scan starts a new document.
name: model.open

description: Opens the demo part: a scanned box with mounting flanges, fillets and holes.
name: model.open_demo

description: Saves the document (.emodel: the scan's mesh and everything modelled on it).
name: model.save

path.description: Where (default: where it was opened or last saved).

description: Creates an empty label (a named region of the scan). Paint seeds into it with model.paint, then model.grow.
name: model.label.create

kinds.description: Surface kinds it may be (default: any; the simplest that fits is chosen).

role.description: face (default): a face of the part; hole: a hole's wall; fillet; ignore: scan that is not the part (table, fixture).

description: Renames a label or changes its role or allowed kinds.
name: model.label.update

label.description: A label: its name or id.

description: Deletes a label with its paint, its region, and the constraints, holes and fillets on it.
name: model.label.delete

label.description: A label: its name or id.

description: Paints seed triangles of a label (or erases paint): a disc of the scan around a point, or listed triangles. A few mm on the middle of a face is enough; model.grow extends it to the whole face.
name: model.paint

erase.description: Erase paint instead (of this label, or of any label when 'label' is not given).

label.description: A label: its name or id.

point.description: A point on or near the scan (mm); the disc is grown from the nearest scan triangle.

triangles.description: Triangle indices instead of a disc.

description: Grows painted labels into whole faces (all together, so neighbours meet at their edge) and fits each one's surface.
name: model.grow

labels.description: Only these (default: every label with paint).

description: Finds faces on the unlabelled scan automatically: planes first, then cylinders, cones, spheres and tori. Labels them ('plane 1', 'cylinder 2', ...), sorts out fillets (cylinders along the edge of two planes), hole walls and fillet corners, and finds the holes in the planes. Rename the labels to meaningful names afterwards.
name: model.detect

description: Makes a label a freeform face (a smooth B-spline surface) for a region no plane, cylinder, cone, sphere or torus describes, e.g. a domed or sculpted top. Fitted to the label's region, or to its paint taken out over the connected unlabelled scan up to sharp creases. Freeform faces are held as fitted (no constraints on them).
name: model.freeform

crease_deg.description: Edges sharper than this stop the extension (default 20).

extend.description: Take in the connected unlabelled scan first (default: when the label has no region).

label.description: A label: its name or id.

spacing_mm.description: Control point spacing (default: about 12 across the region).

description: Finds round holes in a plane label (openings in its region): centre, axis, diameter (from the wall if scanned, else from the opening), through or blind.
name: model.find_holes

label.description: A label: its name or id.

description: Sets a hole's true size from a measurement (overrides the scan's), its depth, or makes it through; and its forms: a counterbore (diameter and depth), a countersink (diameter at the face and included angle, default 90), a drill point at a blind hole's bottom (included angle, 118 for a twist drill; the depth is then to the shoulder). Detection measures the forms it sees; null removes one.
name: model.hole.update

diameter.description: Measured diameter, mm (null: back to the scan's).

hole.description: A hole: its name or id.

point_angle_deg.description: Included angle of a drill point.

description: Deletes a hole.
name: model.hole.delete

hole.description: A hole: its name or id.

description: A fillet on the edge between two faces: from a fillet label (its faces and radius found from it), or between labels 'a' and 'b' with a radius.
name: model.fillet.add

a.description: A label: its name or id.

b.description: A label: its name or id.

label.description: A label: its name or id.

radius.description: Radius, mm (default: measured from the label).

description: Sets a fillet's radius (null: back to the measured one).
name: model.fillet.update

fillet.description: A fillet: its name or id.

description: Deletes a fillet.
name: model.fillet.delete

fillet.description: A fillet: its name or id.

description: A coordinate frame for the part: z along label 'z' (a face's normal or an axis), x as near label 'x''s direction as possible. Solved with the faces; constraints align faces to its axes and offset them from its origin, and the exported part sits in it.
name: model.datum.create

x.description: A label: its name or id.

z.description: A label: its name or id.

description: Deletes a datum and its constraints.
name: model.datum.delete

datum.description: A datum: its name or id.

description: Adds a face the scan did not see (e.g. the bottom the part stood on), as a plane square to a datum axis at an offset from its origin. Needed where the scan is open, or the solid cannot be closed.
name: model.face.add_plane

facing.description: Which way the face looks out of the part: along (+, default) or against (-) the axis.

offset.description: Along the axis from the datum origin, mm.

description: Adds a constraint (held exactly by model.solve): aligned {label, datum, axis}: a face's normal or an axis along a datum axis; parallel / perpendicular / coplanar / coaxial {a, b}; angle {a, b, degrees}; radius {label, value}; diameter {label or hole, value} (a measured hole size); distance {a, b, value}: between parallel planes; offset {label, datum, axis, value}: a face or axis at a position along a datum axis; axis_distance {a, b, value}: two parallel axes this far apart (a hole pitch, or a hole from a boss or bolt-circle centre); tangent {a, b}: a plane and a cylinder or sphere, or two cylinders, touching (a fillet against its faces, a slot's rounded end); symmetric {a, b, datum, axis}: two faces or axes mirrored about the datum's plane normal to that axis; equal_radius {a, b}: the same radius, whatever it is. Where an axis is meant (aligned, parallel, perpendicular, angle, coaxial, offset, axis_distance, symmetric) a hole may be named in place of a label. Prefer one datum with aligned faces over many pairwise perpendicular constraints.
name: model.constraint.add

a.description: A label: its name or id.

b.description: A label: its name or id.

label.description: A label: its name or id.

description: Removes a constraint.
name: model.constraint.remove

description: Aligns plane faces to the nearest axis of a datum (the usual first step for a machined part: 'make the box square').
name: model.square

max_angle_deg.description: Leave out faces further than this from every axis (default 10).

description: Fits every face together under the constraints. Per constraint: satisfied / redundant / conflict / invalid, and what it costs (how far it moved surfaces off the scan); per label: rms, movement from its own best fit, uncertainty; and 'scale': what the measured lengths say about the scan's scale (a factor, and whether it is significant).
name: model.solve

description: Builds the solid from the faces, holes and fillets, then measures the scan's deviation from it (see model.deviation). Says when the faces do not enclose the part (add the missing face where the scan is open).
name: model.build

description: Scales the scan and everything modelled on it (a calibration correction), e.g. by the factor model.solve's 'scale' check suggests from the user's measurements. Clears the undo history.
name: model.scale

description: Makes the scan's mesh again from its source file, when it has changed (model.summary's scan.source is 'changed': e.g. an .estr scanned further or edited in the scanning app). Labels move to the new mesh by nearest triangle, hole openings to the nearest vertices, and fitted faces are refitted; solve and build again after. Clears the undo history. Seconds to minutes for an .estr.
name: model.reprocess

fine.description: For .estr: 0.3 mm voxels (default: as it was processed before).

path.description: The source (default: the scan's own, e.g. after it was moved).

description: Adds photos of the part to the document (stored in the .emodel as the files are: JPEG, HEIC, PNG ...). Photos may be taken anywhere, in another setting than the scan.
name: model.photo.import

data_base64.description: A photo's bytes instead of a file.

description: Renames a photo, sets its caption, or whether it may colour the scan.
name: model.photo.update

photo.description: A photo: its name or id.

use_for_colour.description: Once registered, may colour the scan (off when something covers the part).

description: Removes a photo and its annotations.
name: model.photo.delete

photo.description: A photo: its name or id.

description: Marks something on a photo: a dimension (two points and a length), a diameter (a circle), an angle, a callout (an arrow with text and/or a value) or a note. Named D1, DIA2, A3, C4, N5 ... Links say which labels, holes or fillets it is about. Use it to keep what the user tells you, attached to the picture.
name: model.photo.annotate

links.description: Labels, holes or fillets it is about.

photo.description: A photo: its name or id.

points.description: Photo pixels [[x, y], ...] (as shown, origin top left, y down): dimension 2 (its ends), diameter 3 on the rim or 2 (centre, rim), angle 3 (the vertex in the middle), callout 2 (what it points at, then where its text sits), note 1.

value.description: mm (an angle: degrees), or as typed: '42 mm', '1.5 in', '1 1/2"', 'Ø6', 'R2', '30°', with an optional '±0.05' (null: none).

description: Changes an annotation's points, value, tolerance, text or links.
name: model.photo.annotation.update

annotation.description: An annotation: its name (D1 ...) or id.

links.description: Labels, holes or fillets it is about (replaces them).

points.description: Photo pixels [[x, y], ...] (as shown, origin top left, y down): dimension 2 (its ends), diameter 3 on the rim or 2 (centre, rim), angle 3 (the vertex in the middle), callout 2 (what it points at, then where its text sits), note 1.

value.description: mm (an angle: degrees), or as typed: '42 mm', '1.5 in', '1 1/2"', 'Ø6', 'R2', '30°', with an optional '±0.05' (null: none).

description: Deletes an annotation.
name: model.photo.annotation.delete

annotation.description: An annotation: its name (D1 ...) or id.

description: The photos with their annotations in full (points, values, text, links), and the part's notes. model.photo.get shows one.
name: model.photo.list

description: A photo as an image to look at, scaled down, with its annotations drawn and named as in model.photo.list. Optionally a crop of it, or a grid labelled with photo pixel coordinates to point at things with (model.photo.annotate).
name: model.photo.get

crop.description: [x, y, w, h] in photo pixels.

max_size.description: Longer side of the image, px (default 1600).

overlay.description: A registered photo: draw the model's edges (or the label boundaries) over it, to check the registration and compare model and part (default false).

photo.description: A photo: its name or id.

description: Matches a point of the part in a photo (pixel) to the same point on the scan (e.g. from model.raycast). With 6 matched points (4 when EXIF gives the focal length) the photo's camera is solved, relative to the part only: then annotations get the scan's own reading, links are suggested, and model.photo.get can draw the model over the photo. Spread the points over the part, at corners and edges that are easy to place exactly. Points on scan labelled ignore (not the part) are refused.
name: model.photo.correspond

photo.description: A photo: its name or id.

point.description: The same point on the scan, mm.

description: Removes a matched point (the camera is solved again).
name: model.photo.correspond.remove

photo.description: A photo: its name or id.

description: Solves the photo's camera again from its matched points; reports each point's error in px and which disagree with the rest.
name: model.photo.register

photo.description: A photo: its name or id.

description: For a registered photo: what a pixel shows on the part (a point and its label), and/or where a scan point appears in the photo (and whether the part hides it there).
name: model.photo.project

photo.description: A photo: its name or id.

description: Writes down a fact about the part that is not in the scan: material, finish, a thread, 'the bottom is flat', what it mates with. Kept in the document for later sessions.
name: model.note.add

description: Rewrites a note.
name: model.note.update

description: Deletes a note.
name: model.note.delete

description: Writes the built solid as STEP (AP242, mm, faces named after labels) and reads it back to check.
name: model.export_step

description: What the modelling app's 3D view shows and from where (then ui.screenshot to see it). mode: labels (each label's colour; painted seeds brighter), deviation (green within tolerance, yellow-red where the scan is outside the model, cyan-blue inside), model (the built solid). preset: look from top, bottom, front, back, left, right or iso (in the first datum's axes when there is one). frame: fit a label (or 'all') in the view.
name: model.view

orbit.description: [dx, dy] radians, as a left-drag would.

preset.description: Look from (scanned: the side the scanner saw the surface from).

zoom.description: Multiply the distance by this (0.5: twice as close).

description: Starts a change: everything until model.end_change is one undo step (use it around each request you carry out).
name: model.begin_change

description.description: What the change does, as the user sees it in the history.

description: Ends the change begun with model.begin_change.
name: model.end_change

description: Undoes the last change.
name: model.undo

description: Redoes the last undone change.
name: model.redo
